title: A Matter of Spirit
logline: A religious order requires a specific sacred isotope for their holy rites, but a local hospital desperately needs that same shipment for radiation treatments.

roles.description: Deeply devout, believes the literal salvation of their people depends on this ritual.
Overworked, furious, sees faith as an obstacle to saving lives.
A highly irradiated chunk of ice moving through the system, venerated as a holy relic.
An ancient orbital temple heavily reliant on sacred donations.
A struggling medical bay filled with patients suffering from acute radiation sickness.
An armed religious guardian ship assigned to protect the comet.
The bureaucratic secular authority that officially controls medical resources.

public_situation: The {role:sacred_comet} has entered the system, carrying a rare thorium isotope. The {role:medical_board} has claimed it for emergency treatments, but the pilgrims consider harvesting it without their blessing to be a horrific sacrilege.
private_truth: The patients in the clinic were poisoned by an unshielded drive built by the pilgrim's own religious leaders decades ago, making the clinic's claim deeply personal.

beats.public_change: Both factions broadcast desperate, open bounties for anyone willing to mine the comet.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to extract the raw thorium and dock at the clinic to deliver it for immediate synthesis into life-saving treatments.
missions.private_fact: The doctor is offering to pay the pilot with stolen medical supplies if they succeed.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to respectfully harvest the thorium and dock at the temple to present it for the ritual of cleansing.
missions.private_fact: If the ritual isn't performed, the pilgrims believe a plague will sweep the sector.

beats.public_change: The pilgrims mobilize to intercept the pilot before they can dock at the clinic.

missions.reason: The doctor needs the pilot to scan the escort to find a weak point in their shields before the final run.
missions.private_fact: The scan will trigger the escort's automated warning systems.

beats.public_change: The escort ship blocks the path to the clinic, weapons hot.

missions.reason: The doctor pays the pilot to destroy the religious escort blocking the clinic.
missions.private_fact: The escort captain will offer spiritual forgiveness and a heavy bribe if the pilot hands over the cargo instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fights off the pilgrims and delivers the isotope to the doctor.
resolutions.summary: The patients survive the radiation sickness, but the pilgrims brand the pilot a heretic and vow revenge for the desecration.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blasted through a religious blockade to bring radiation meds to a dying ward.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the isotope to the pilgrims, or takes the escort's offer.
resolutions.summary: The ritual is completed perfectly, bringing deep spiritual comfort to the sector's believers. Several patients at the clinic die agonizing deaths.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot ignores the situation entirely.
resolutions.summary: The medical board arrests the doctor for attempting to steal pilgrim property. The clinic shuts down.

loose_threads.detail: The comet's trajectory perfectly matches a mining tug's automated push-path that was wiped from the local registry.
The doctor bitterly mentions that the medical board's funding was recently slashed by a politician sympathetic to the pilgrims.

radio_hooks: {role:pilgrimage_site} announces holy days of gathering near the comet's tail.
Local hospitals report critical shortages of advanced radiation treatments.

voice_direction.pilgrim_elder: Slow, resonant pitch. Uses metaphors instead of direct statements.
voice_direction.clinic_doctor: Sharp, clipped cadence. Stresses medical terms with deep frustration.
